items.title: Winning Reviews, Losing Discovery? The Co-Evolutionary Game of AI Research and Peer Review

items.insightText: 优先找可复用的工程范式、组织实践和系统架构细节，低相关议题可直接跳过。

items.title: REINS: A Self-Evolving Agent Harness for Real-Time Trajectory Planning
